observations.why: The clause 'the e2e suite asserts that' is a signature formula framing a test-system claim as the authority behind the assertion — a recurring organizational stock-phrase that delegates epistemic weight to the suite.

evidence.quote: exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is spoken of AS a carrier — a vessel whose sole purpose is to transport an assertion — a thing functioning as another thing, not mere vividness.
